# Snorkel Nice Okinawa

> English-first information and inquiry site for snorkeling tours and related marine activities in Okinawa, Japan.

Canonical URL: https://snorkel.nice.okinawa/
Booking email: info@nice.okinawa
Service area: Okinawa, Japan

## Services

- Kerama-area snorkeling plans departing from Ginowan Marina
- Blue Cave snorkeling options
- Private snorkeling charters
- Snorkeling and fishing combination plans
- Separately arranged island activities, including snorkeling, SUP and kayaking
- Pickup, language support, photography and car-rental coordination may be arranged depending on the plan

Prices, inclusions, participant eligibility, exact locations and cancellation terms vary by plan and must be confirmed before booking.

## Booking information to provide

Send the preferred date, group size, participant ages, hotel area, preferred plan, swimming experience, relevant health information and pickup needs. A booking is not confirmed until availability and plan details are agreed.
